subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support `streamTo="parent"`, and if so what child progress, tool data, redaction, and routing contract is allowed to cross into the parent session/channel?
rationale: Current code can ignore the parameter safely, but implementing live native progress would change what child-session data is surfaced to parent users and channels, which is a product and security boundary choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Design redacted native progress relay
options.body: Add native subagent parent progress only for bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester-session routing, cleanup, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

options.title: Keep ACP-only streamTo
options.body: Document `streamTo` as permanently ACP-only and leave native subagents on completion events plus status/subagents inspection.

options.title: Expose structured child event stream
options.body: Build a broader child-event subscription surface for native subagents, but require a larger design covering tool output, thinking visibility, and channel-specific delivery limits.

recommendation.title: Design redacted native progress relay
recommendation.body: Add native subagent parent progress only for bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester-session routing, cleanup, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source blame and recent subagent history put Peter closest to the current agent/session boundary and maintainer-level security tradeoff.
